operationalSituations.description: Developer runs rsfusa during local development to check their Rust code
CI/CD pipeline runs rsfusa as an automated gate on pull requests and main branch pushes
Safety auditor reviews evidence bundles produced by rsfusa for certification submission

hazards.description: False negative: rsfusa fails to report a genuine safety rule violation in Rust source code
hazards.mitigation: Qualification test suite (rsfusa qualify) verifies each rule detects known-bad inputs; CI gate enforces qualification on every build

hazards.description: Wrong ASIL determination: rsfusa derives incorrect integrity level from configuration parameters
hazards.mitigation: ASIL lookup table is derived directly from ISO 26262 Part 3 Table 4; HARA subcommand provides independent cross-check

hazards.description: Silent failure: rsfusa encounters an internal error but exits 0, masking the failure from CI
hazards.mitigation: All error paths explicitly return EXIT_RUNTIME (3); qualification suite tests error exit codes; CI fails on unexpected exit codes

hazards.description: Evidence integrity violation: audit pack contents are tampered with after generation, undetected
hazards.mitigation: audit-pack generates manifest.json with SHA-256 per entry; rsfusa sign provides HMAC-SHA256 signing for offline verification

hazards.description: Configuration silently disables safety checks through excludePaths or disposition suppression
hazards.mitigation: Dispositions are logged in .fusa-dispositions.json with mandatory rationale; rsfusa trace reports all suppressed requirements

safetyGoals.description: rsfusa shall report every safety rule violation — no false negatives in qualified rules
ASIL allocation shall match the configured integrity level per ISO 26262 Part 3 Table 4
rsfusa shall exit non-zero on any ERROR finding or internal analysis failure
Evidence bundles shall include SHA-256 hashes for all artefacts to enable tamper detection
rsfusa shall emit a WARNING when safety checks are suppressed via disposition or excludePaths
